newsitem.title: UK: Shield predicts loss above market forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Shield predicts loss above market forecasts.

text.p: British diagnostics company Shield Diagnostics Plc said on Thursday it expected to make a pretax loss for the year to March 1997 which will be outside the current range of market expectations.

The company said the loss would result from one-off costs of 70,000 pounds, the writing off of a 378,000-pound intangible asset associated with the infectious disease products purchased in 1992 and its current operating loss.
Shield said it had sufficient cash reserves to cover its anticipated loss and said it did not expect to have to seek external short-term funding.
Shield said it expected a shortfall in sales because of a loss in turnover in its infectious disease business unit.

It said sales of its OEM-based syphilis test and delayed sales of its chlamydia test in Germany had contributed to this. Accordingly it decided to cut overheads to maintain investment in the Discovery product development division, Shield said. The company said it was confident its overhead structure was aligned with current turnover and said there were visible signs of progress with its Discovery division.
